issue.title: fib & decap tests failed because of KeyError: 'members'

resolution.title: [chassis] Fix fib & decap test
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/14028 removed the lag member collection from PORTCHANNEL table in config db. This breaks fib & decap tests. Fix this by retrieving lag members from  PORTCHANNEL_MEMBER table.

This PR fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/7658.
